messages.subject: Calderdale House — COMPLETED
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Elena,

We confirm completion has taken place. We have received the completion monies, the transfer (TR1) is dated 28 March, and our undertaking to discharge the Pennine Business Bank charge and provide the DS1 stands. The Castleford rent deposit of £29,250 has been transferred to your client account. Original documents to follow by DX.

A pleasure working with you.

Regards,
Alistair

messages.subject: Calderdale House — COMPLETED, you are the owner
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Frances,

Completion has taken place — Ellwood Estates is now the registered proprietor (subject to registration) of Calderdale House. The transfer is dated today. Next we will: submit the SDLT return and pay the £412,000, apply to register your title at HM Land Registry, and serve notices of assignment of the reversion on the three tenants so they pay rent to you. We'll send the completed file in due course.

Congratulations on the acquisition.

Kind regards,
Elena

—
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
